messages:
Elaine: Quick heads-up: We need a hot patch for 1.9.12 -> 1.9.13 to fix KV cache eviction bug. Plan to cut tonight 02:00 UTC (in ~3h). Minimal diff: backport only kv-fix and test harness. Need LGTM, CI green, and one QA smoke. @Mike can you own cherry-pick + smoke?

Mike: On it. I'll cherry-pick the commit (sha abc1234) and open PR. ETA 30m. Will run unit + kv-integration locally.

Jenn: QA can run smoke at 02:20 UTC. Tag me in PR. Are there migrations? :thinking_face:

Ash: No DB migrations. Config tweak to kvcache timeout (defaults preserved).

Sara: I'll prepare changelog note: "Fix KV cache eviction under high-concurrency causing 500s". Keep it short.

Mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4921 — includes cherry-pick and tiny test. cc @Tim for release notes.

Tim: LGTM from my side, just one nit in the test. I'll push fix.

Mike: Fixed nit, CI rerun.

repo-bot: CI status: pending (build #1204).

qa-bot: Staging smoke env deployed at sha abc1234. Run: `/smoke run kv-hotpath` — results expected by 02:10 UTC.

Jenn: Smoke passed on key paths. Saw one 429 spike on prefix test, probably unrelated. :white_check_mark:

Elaine: @all rolling window: cutoff for merging is 01:45 UTC. If PR isn't merged by then we hold for next cycle. Prepare rollback instructions. @Mike include rollback tag in PR.

Mike: Added rollback note in PR description with tag `rollback/v1.9.13` and quick revert script.

deploy-bot: Release plan scheduled: 1.9.13 -> deploy 02:00 UTC to canary (10%) then 02:10 full. If errors >0.5% auto rollback.

Ash: I'll monitor metrics channel at deploy. I'll also make sure fallback policy routes to 1.9.12.

Sara: Changelog PR: docs/releases/1.9.13.md created.

Elaine: Thanks team. If anything slips ping #oncall. Otherwise let's keep it minimal and tight. :rocket:
